information_budget.observation_window: Only numeric actual time within0-24h and the mean time-zero log burden for the linked strain-study are prediction inputs. Different time-zero animals supply declared cohort calibration. No later burden, laboratory parameter, animal outcome or study/strain identity is a numerical predictor. Numeric <24 strings and censored inequality burdens are not exact-time targets.
information_budget.calibration_and_history: DSM/site-reference strain aliases resolved from source RefToDict plus explicit single-strain-study Overview links (source labeling discrepancies retained) and kept together. All ExperimentResults sheets included. Explicit untreated CFU lung single-value observations only, equality operator, compatible log-CFU lung units, numeric actual times 0–24 h. Time-zero animals form an explicitly allowed cohort calibration, not the same later animals. Non-numeric early-death times and censoring cannot be interpreted as exact scheduled times; exclusions are counted, and this creates survivorship/measurement selection limits. Source already reports virulence/reproducibility criteria; no new clinical efficacy claim. Source laboratory directory supplies validation identity; the original SITE field is inconsistent in one workbook and is preserved as provided_site. Header templates and source censoring inconsistencies require caution.
information_budget.source_selectors_policy: Only native observations underlying these declared quantities, within this timing/calibration contract. An archive hash is not permission to use every member or column. New channels require reviewed budget amendment.
information_budget.native_channel_rule: Resolve native channels through the bound preparation adapter and parent input units; extra channels are prohibited until explicit admission.

feature_policy: Alternative deterministic or training-fitted feature extraction is permitted within this source-level budget; feature names need not equal prepared columns. Declare exact member/column/window selectors and fitting groups.
target_policy: Target construction, eligible rows, groups and baseline predictions inherit the frozen parent unchanged.
review_policy: Prediction-only scoring validates declarations and numerical alignment; verified raw-information compliance requires bound computational and scientific review. This is not a sandbox or proof of training independence.
scope_ambiguities: Reserved endpoints all at24h; kinetics and nonrandom humane-endpoint exclusions limit the task.
Only 1 scoring groups; no dependent-row population inference.
